title: 9th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/9/3/2025).

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Higher Education, Labour and Skills Development, Dr Ali Haidar Ahmed: the TVET training centre at B. Kihaadhoo has been closed since July 2024 and its building is deteriorating; when will it be repaired and reopened?
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending Law No. 24/2014 (Special Economic Zones Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau.

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on its review of the matter sent to Parliament to appoint three members to the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Commission under Article 17(a)(1) of Law No. 16/2025 (Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Act).
Vote on whether to accept the Bill amending Law No. 8/2009 (Maldives Pension Act), submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Vote on whether to accept the resolution submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim on the serious difficulty of obtaining blood in the Maldives and how to resolve it.
Vote on whether to accept the Human Organ Transplant Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Feydhoo South MP Ibrahim Didi.
Voting on other items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to question the Higher Education Minister on the closed Kihaadhoo TVET centre, open debate on the Special Economic Zones amendment, consider media commission appointments, and vote on accepting a pension bill, a blood-supply resolution and an organ transplant bill.
